back_translation: Wake right up with the first sip.
notes: The pun on 'grind' (coffee grinding and hard work) doesn't survive in Arabic, where 'اطحن' just sounds like crushing something, so I kept the wake-up-and-get-going idea with the energetic Gulf colloquial 'صحصح' and tied it to the coffee ritual rather than hustle-culture slang.
